summary: Focused regression test to verify the reported bug 'Uncaught Error — Cannot read properties of undefined (reading replace)' is fully resolved. Exercised every route and interaction listed in the review request on BOTH mobile (390x844) and tablet (1280x800) viewports against https://cyber-logistics-hub-1.preview.emergentagent.com (wired to remote backend https://logistics-hub-1349.emergent.host). Routes visited: /(tabs) Overview, /(tabs)/shipments (all 5 filter chips clicked + search typed + first row tapped into detail), /shipment/new (opened + cancelled), /(tabs)/parties (all role chips clicked + search typed + first row tapped), /party/new, /(tabs)/ledger (summary/get/give/entries tabs clicked), /(tabs)/more, /invoices, /items, /warehouses, /lalamove, /invoice/new. Captured console errors and pageerror events, and scanned page HTML for red-box overlay keywords (TypeError, Uncaught, 'reading replace', 'Cannot read properties of undefined') after every step. RESULT: 0 page errors, 0 console errors, 0 red-box matches on any route in either viewport. PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: All previously flagged .replace() / .toLowerCase() / .slice() call sites now use `|| ""` (or `|| "-"`) fallbacks — verified by exercising every route that renders those fields.

The two P2 issues from iteration_1 (parties chip vertical gap and missing parties-search testID) also appear resolved — parties-search testID is now present and used by the test, and no layout regression was seen on the parties screen at either viewport.

success_rate.backend: n/a (remote live backend, not tested per instructions)
success_rate.frontend: 100% - all navigable routes clean, zero uncaught errors

context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading replace)' is verified FIXED across every route/tab/filter/search on mobile 390x844 and tablet 1280x800. If a future regression appears, focus on card renderers in shipments.tsx (mode/direction badges), index.tsx ModeBar, and shipment/[id].tsx metric/route blocks where backend-nullable strings are formatted.
rca_of_issue: Original RCA (from main agent): shipment/party records from the remote backend can have null/undefined `mode`, `direction`, `origin`, `destination`, `consignment_no`, `phone`, `name` fields; direct `.replace()`/`.toLowerCase()`/`.slice()` on these threw 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading replace)'. Fix: every such call now uses `(field || "")` (or `|| "-"` for display strings) fallback. Verified: no such error observed when navigating all routes and interacting with all chips, tabs, and search inputs on both viewports.
